lessons.title: "I Am Near"
lessons.objective: Recognise God's nearness to the one who calls
lessons.hook: What changes when you believe your call is heard?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: I am indeed nearmost. I answer the supplicant’s call when he calls Me.

lessons.summary: Surah al-Baqarah 2:186 says God is near and answers the one who calls on Him, and it asks people to respond to Him and to have faith in Him.

questions.prompt: What does 2:186 say about God's nearness?
options: He is far from the supplicant
questions.explanation: The verse says: I am indeed nearmost.

questions.prompt: What does God do when the supplicant calls, according to this quote?
questions.explanation: The quote says: I answer the supplicant's call when he calls Me.

lessons.title: Praise Before Asking
lessons.objective: Notice that praise comes before requests
lessons.hook: Why might a prayer begin with praise before it asks for anything?

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful, Master of the Day of Retribution.

sources.author: The Qur'an
sources.quote: Guide us on the straight path,

lessons.summary: Surah al-Fatihah 1:2-4 is praise of Allah: Lord of all the worlds, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful, Master of the Day of Retribution. The request in the surah, "Guide us on the straight path" (1:6), comes after these verses.

questions.prompt: Put the opening of Surah al-Fatihah in order.
items: Praise of Allah, Lord of all the worlds (1:2)
The request: guide us on the straight path (1:6)
questions.explanation: The surah opens with praise, and the request for guidance comes after it.
These verses open with praise belonging to Allah.

candidates: SAHIFA Supplication 1 (praise of God): add when the page can be read.

questions.prompt: What is the promise in 14:7 for those who are grateful?

questions.explanation: The verse says: If you are grateful, I will surely enhance you.

options: Thanking those who helped you and noticing what you have
questions.explanation: The verse links gratitude with increase.

sources.quote: The parable of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is that of a grain which grows seven ears

questions.explanation: The verse compares it to a grain which grows seven ears.

questions.prompt: What does the image suggest about giving?
options: It always shrinks what you have
questions.explanation: One grain yields seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains.
